parsed.public_message: Blue: Beginning our announced descent off the West Plateau this turn into the western edge of our agreed lane (x=430-450, z=670-710). Holding well west of x=460 and north of z=660. Pact reaffirmed: neutral to all, no first strike through t=450, and one full turn of public notice before any hostility.

private_messages.Claude: Beginning our descent off the plateau this turn to the western edge of our box (x=430-450, z=670-710). No eyes on White yet from the plateau, but our northern screen at (440,710) will be near the western foot of the Heights next turn—will share anything we spot.
private_messages.GPT: As requested, letting you know our descent off the West Plateau begins this turn. We are settling on the western edge of our box (x=430-450, z=670-710), keeping over 220m clear of your central lowland position. Pact solid through t=450.
private_messages.Grok: Stepping down off the West Plateau this turn to the western edge of our lane (x=430-450, z=670-710). We stay west of x=450, leaving a 70m+ buffer from your x=520-660 corridor. Pact holds firm.

parsed.notes_to_self: Turn 11 (t=250s): Ring 580m -> 500m at t=275s -> 420m at t=300s. Moving off West Plateau early to clear ramp bottleneck and form up at western edge of our lowland lane (x=430-450, z=670-710), dist ~195-215m from centre (inside even the t=450s 220m ring!). Formation faces east: vanguard (450,695), elephants (445,682), wardens (450,670) in front; hero (438,682) and archers (430,682) behind; companions at (440,710) screening north flank; surgeons guarding hero. Intel: Green main body at ~(680,623) archer-heavy + scout (780,830); Orange main body on Little Hill + rider south of z=600; White on Central Heights (x=520-660) + 4x Odrysian cav near (658,825).
parsed.explanation: We begin our descent off the West Plateau a turn before the 420 m ring reaches the plateau edge so that our elephants and infantry clear the slope bottleneck without congestion. Our squads form an east-facing defensive line along x=430–450, z=670–710—already inside the t=450 s ring radius—while maintaining full transparency and wide buffers with all three neutral neighbours.
